title: Audio Visualizer
description: This Song Visualizer was built as a self-project, using purely p5.js, and its built in FFT and PerlinNoise functionalities. Has got a full music player capabilities(stop, rewind, play, etc.). Also has a convinient navigation system using WASD. A song upload or link to Youtube / Spotify is going to be added in the future

media.caption: A small demo of the website. I recommend checking the website yourself.
